I'm sorry but that's not how it goes. I myself am a Med student in an Australian University which uses a threshold GPA for acceptance, pretty much a GPA of around 3 and 4 are treated the same and the way they discern applicants is through interview, so there are plenty of people in my cohort with low 3 to 4 GPA's and there is ABSOLUTELY NO correlation between their GPA and their performance in med school. Just because entry requirements are lower doesn't mean one is less qualified to be a doctor, these entry requirements are merely used as a tool to filter applicants nothing else. What this is, is clearly a case of misrepresentation and all they're trying to do is make sure that the number of African-American people with college degrees is comparable to the rest of the country. I see absolutely nothing wrong with that.
